route_title: Constrained Local Refinement with Bounded Step Size
compilation_rationale: Bounded 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack compiled with provided thicknesses and ±15 nm absolute bounds. Spectral targets maximize mean transmittance in 800–1500 nm and mean reflectance in 200–400 nm at normal unpolarized incidence. Harmonic QW penalty at 1150 nm is enforced via optimizer regularization. Uncertainty modeled as absolute-normal 15 nm deviation.
